name: Card Swipe
description: The first clip is flicked off like the top card of a stack while the second card behind it grows to fill the frame. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: direction
params.description: Direction the first card is flicked (x right, y up)

params.name: rotation
params.description: How much the first card swings as it flies out

params.name: depth
params.description: How much smaller the second card starts

params.name: back_color
params.description: Color around the second card while it is smaller than the frame
